title: The JA Boxing 1.0.7 contract carries a complete Slot fit, so Road to live does not hold it and the hero boxer asks for a transparent cut-out
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/content-coverage.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the test named below.
expect: Release 1.0.7 of ja-boxing judged against the shipped contracts has fitState ready and fitHolds false.
The 1.0.7 content map declares slotFitVersion slot-fit/1, and slot module-156.1 has fit kind cutout with transparent true.
evidence: Every released JA Boxing contract up to 1.0.6 had no Slot fit and marked 198 of 257 pictures keep, so builds from a site brief broke the layout.
fence: The 1.0.7 contract under packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts/ja-boxing/j6/1.0.7 declares a measured fit on every text and image slot.

tests: fit group: the released JA Boxing 1.0.7 contract carries a complete Slot fit, so nothing holds and the hero boxer asks for a cut-out
